title: The Clay Bead on the Skewer
youtube_title: The Clay Bead on the Skewer | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Some good things arrive only when they are not poked.
summary: At a greenhouse bench with seed pots and a south window, Gita wants to check on a row of clay beads drying on a skewer before it is ready. With Auntie June nearby, Gita leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
